verses.text: My little children, I write these things to you so that you will not sin. But if anyone does sin, we have someone who speaks to the Father for us, Jesus Christ, the one who is right.
He is the sacrifice that takes away our sins. And not only our sins, but the sins of the whole world.
This is how we know that we know him: if we obey his commands.
Anyone who says, "I know him," but does not obey his commands, is a liar, and the truth is not in him.
But whoever obeys his word, God's love has truly become complete in that person. This is how we know that we are in him:
anyone who says he lives in him must live the way Jesus lived.
Dear friends, I am not writing you a new command. It is an old command that you have had from the beginning. This old command is the message you have already heard.
And yet I am writing you a new command. Its truth is seen in him and in you, because the darkness is passing away, and the true light is already shining.
Anyone who says he is in the light but hates his brother is still in the darkness, even now.
Anyone who loves his brother lives in the light, and there is nothing in him to make him fall.
But anyone who hates his brother is in the darkness. He walks in the darkness and does not know where he is going, because the darkness has made him blind.
I write to you, little children, because your sins are forgiven because of the name of Jesus.

I write to you, fathers, because you know him who has been there from the beginning. I write to you, young men, because you have won the fight against the evil one. I write to you, little children, because you know the Father.

I have written to you, fathers, because you know him who has been there from the beginning. I have written to you, young men, because you are strong, the word of God lives in you, and you have won the fight against the evil one.
Do not love the world or the things in the world. If anyone loves the world, the love of the Father is not in him.
Everything in the world, the wrong desires of the body, the greedy desires of the eyes, and the proud showing off of what we have, does not come from the Father. It comes from the world.
The world and its wrong desires are passing away, but whoever does what God wants will live forever.
Little children, this is the last hour. You heard that the Antichrist is coming, and even now many antichrists have come. That is how we know that it is the last hour.
They went out from us, but they did not really belong to us. If they had belonged to us, they would have stayed with us. But they left, and that showed that none of them belonged to us.
But you have been anointed by the Holy One, and all of you know the truth.
I am not writing to you because you do not know the truth. I write because you do know it, and because no lie comes from the truth.
Who is the liar? It is the one who says that Jesus is not the Christ. That person is the Antichrist, the one who rejects both the Father and the Son.
Anyone who rejects the Son does not have the Father. Anyone who confesses the Son has the Father too.
So make sure that what you heard from the beginning stays in you. If what you heard from the beginning stays in you, you will also stay in the Son and in the Father.
And this is what he promised us: life that lasts forever.
I am writing these things to you about the people who are trying to lead you the wrong way.

But as for you, the anointing you received from him stays in you, so you do not need anyone to teach you. His anointing teaches you about everything, and it is true, not a lie. So stay in him, just as it has taught you.
And now, little children, stay in him. Then when he appears, we can be bold and not be ashamed in front of him when he comes.
If you know that he is right and good, you also know that everyone who does what is right has been born of him.
